title: release.sh checks for a running app before it updates the checkout
notes: scripts/release.sh, after the release is out (around line 107): git merge --ff-only origin/main, then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, tsc, eslint, test, and only then scripts/rebuild.sh, whose first step is node scripts/no-running-app.mjs. So someone running a dev Dashboard out of this checkout (a contributor, or any version other than the installed build) has its source and node_modules rewritten under it before the check stops the script. Run node scripts/no-running-app.mjs before the merge, stopping with the same --resume hint as the rest of this stage. Keep the install: tsc, eslint and test after it need node_modules, so do not delete it. Keep rebuild.sh's own check (it runs alone too). Docs: docs/workflow (or wherever release.sh is described) and its history line.
